description: Western Province - Announcing that the Removl of Mr. Lionel Appuhami from the Director Board Membership of western Province Industrial Development Authority with immediate effect
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Mr. Lionel Appuhami) and details his removal from a government position (member of the Director Board). It also names the authority making the decision (Provincial Minister Kajitan Lalith Wanigarathne) and provides the detailed ministerial portfolios he holds (Roads, Transport, Co-operative Development and Trade, Fisheries, Housing and Construction, Urban and Estate Sector Infrastructure Facilities, Industries and Rural Development). This combination of specific personnel action and detailed portfolio responsibilities meets the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
